events.caption: First contact exchanges the colors; object identities stay fixed.
Separate and reposition the same objects for a second contact.
The second contact exchanges the colors back.

setup: Two separate contacts. Reposition the same bodies between trials; preserve their colors.
name: Contact color swap

oracle.name: Contact color swap
oracle.law: Free single-sphere bodies, including added ones, swap colors once per contact onset. Another swap requires separation and renewed contact. Motion otherwise follows ordinary physics.
oracle.plain: When two balls touch, they swap colors.
oracle.plain_zh: 两个球一接触，就交换颜色。
oracle.formula: (color A, color B) → (color B, color A)
oracle.condition: Two free single-sphere bodies begin a new contact.
oracle.effect: Their colors swap once. Their object identities do not swap.
oracle.scope: Sustained contact does not repeat the swap. Separation followed by renewed contact does.

reference: Same geometry, masses and scripted actions; the altered program is disabled only in the ordinary-physics reference.
